<?php
/* Gravity Forms style: activation hook here, upload dir there, a copy() somewhere else, thousands of lines apart. */
register_activation_hook(__FILE__, array('GF', 'activate'));
function gf_logs_dir() { $u = wp_upload_dir(); return $u['basedir'] . '/gravity_forms/logs'; }
function gf_export_backup($from, $to) { return copy($from, $to); }
